title: lilium elatum
intro: Lilium elatum, commonly known as the Royal Lily, is a species of lily native to the mountainous regions of western North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its antitussive and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lilium elatum include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its use in wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the Royal Lily include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties and further research is needed to fully understand its potential health benefits.
